subject: a narrow whitewashed village lane with shallow arches
art_direction: 白色小村拱巷与陶色台阶向上延伸，一盆克制绿植点缀，顶端天空自然空净。
visible_description: 白色小村拱巷与陶色台阶向上延伸，一盆克制绿植点缀，顶端天空自然空净。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a narrow whitewashed village lane with shallow arches. Arrange the arches and steps through the lower four fifths, leaving a calm blue opening above the highest wall. Use warm reflected light in the recesses and crisp white sunlit planes. One small plant sits near a doorway without becoming a lush garden. Keep all walls and doors free of lettering. Use gouache architectural scene. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
